title: I saw the man with a telescope
instructions: This sentence is ambiguous under the grammar. Build either reading: the telescope can be how you saw, or something the man has. Both are accepted.
grammar:
# An educational fragment of English, not a grammar of the language.
S       -> NP VP
NP      -> Pronoun | Det N | NP PP
VP      -> V NP | VP PP
PP      -> P NP
Pronoun -> "I" | "she"
Det     -> "the" | "a"
N       -> "man" | "telescope" | "hill" | "park" | "student" | "book"
V       -> "saw" | "reads"
P       -> "with" | "on" | "in"

answer_key.description: Every parse the Earley parser finds for this sentence under the “Prepositional-phrase attachment” grammar. Any of them is accepted.
